description: This file defines an React context provider and hooks for handling user authentication in a React application using Supabase. It manages session state, provides login and logout functions, and exposes user info and roles for use across the app.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component providing authentication context to its children.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access the authentication context, throws error if used outside of AuthProvider.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Hook to retrieve the current user's role from metadata.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias for useAuth, maintained for backward compatibility.

methods.name: signInWithEmail
methods.description: Function to initiate email sign-in with OTP.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Function to sign out the current user.
